title: Hot Smoked Egyptian Salmon Tagine
description: A funky and gooey Egyptian dish featuring hot smoked flaked salmon, perfect for midnight cravings, made with low-glycemic-friendly ingredients and served in a bento box. This recipe combines the flavors of Egypt with the convenience of a bento box meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the onion, garlic, and ginger until well combined.
Add the coriander, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the mortar and pestle and pound until well combined.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the pounded mixture to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the hot smoked salmon to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the salmon is heated through.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a bento box and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
